conflicts.description: Switch Reference p13 Trough Opto prints 515-0215-00 tx / 515-0215-01 rx; the long-range opto assembly BOM p36 prints 500-0215-00 emitter / 500-0215-01 receiver. The common suffix and assembly class suggest a prefix discrepancy, but exact assembly-to-trough fitment is not independently proven. Both literal assertions are retained; no canonical sensor PN selected. Resolution path: consult factory revision/parts documentation or inspect the actual trough sensor and its assembly marking.

The manual CPU DIP/service numbering omits 0-SW-1 and shifts the subsequent printed addresses; exact ROM Node 0 positions 0–7 mirror physical DIP ordinals 1–8 as public 101–108 and positions 8–11 are Select/Plus/Minus/Back public 109–112. Canonical public bindings follow verified ROM routing; source-literal addresses remain aliases. Resolution path: check factory CPU mapping documentation or exact machine wiring to resolve the printed numbering discrepancy; do not remap the API from printed IDs alone.
conflicts.rationale: The ordinal and function joins establish the physical DIP/service identity and exact public routing. The remaining printed address shift is an alias/wiring-detail discrepancy without uncertainty about the recreation-facing functions.

drivers.variant_notes: Exact selected ROM for this physical edition; other physical editions are not folded into this record.

mechanisms.behavior: PDF/folio 36: score bank 511-7614-00 contains four score reel assemblies 511-7648-00 and eight white LED boards 520-5307-00. Credit assembly 511-7615-00 contains one credit reel 511-7648-01 and one white LED board. Individual reel 511-7648-00 uses unipolar stepper motor 041-5105-00, reel 515-9819-00, motor bracket 535-1131-00, and opto sensor PCB 520-6960-00. Driver Reference 17-31 supplies credit/1s/10s/100s/1000s enable plus phase 1 and phase 2 wires; Switch Reference 46-50 identifies one opto home input per reel. This proves the actuator/sensor topology and a home mark. The drawing shows direct shaft drive of each reel. Ball path is not applicable to these backbox devices. Internal enable/phase lines are manual Driver17..31 atNode11 LP15..1; they are withheld from the public lamp export and are not public coils17..31. GetMech can expose internal subsystem positions, but no digit calibration or exact registration order is asserted by this draft. Unresolved: No manual timing, step-to-digit calibration, direction sequence, startup homing order, mechanical zero phase, jam timeout, retry/reset behavior or homing switch rest construction is specified on the reviewed pages. Successor supplied-table evidence now records the script consumption of GetMech(4) for this reel, rounded at 10 steps per displayed digit and modulo 10. This is the script conversion only; the physical calibration, homing and failure behavior above remain unresolved.
